summary: The preregistered liquidation-sweep, range-reclaim and MSS signal was retested with post-only passive mitigation rather than taker-chasing. All causal, passive-order and source-boundary tests passed, but none of 1,024 immutable policies survived the 2023 fit gate. There were 34 fit events. The frozen ordering selected a one-trade candidate as best: +10.3456 bp after 12 bp stress, +4.3456 bp after 18 bp, and -1.6544 bp after 24 bp. Removing its only positive event leaves zero trades and zero return. Development was therefore not opened. This exact passive sweep-MSS payoff is retired without adjacent tuning.
trader_translation: Completed prior external liquidity was raided with actual Bybit forced liquidations, then opposite aggressive flow, BBO refill, range reclaim and a completed MSS confirmed rejection. A post-only order waited at the raided liquidity level or 50% mitigation of the sweep-to-MSS leg; touch alone was not a fill. The structure did not create repeatable after-cost fills even after avoiding taker entry costs.

interpretation.supported: The causal liquidation sweep, reclaim and MSS state can be reconstructed with realistic post-only acknowledgement, rejection, penetration fill and one-slot routing.
interpretation.rejected: Waiting passively at the swept level or half-leg mitigation does not turn the exact signal into a repeatable positive-expectancy payoff.
interpretation.retired_dependency: Liquidation sweep plus reclaim plus MSS followed by passive mitigation at the swept level or half displacement leg.
interpretation.next_information_requirement: Change the information source or the structural state; do not tune adjacent mitigation, queue or target parameters.
